concerns.text: The specification defines Success Criterion SC-005 (pipeline runtime < 2 hours). No task in the checklist records, measures, or validates the actual execution time, so this acceptance criterion is effectively dropped and cannot be verified.

Constitution Principle V requires every artifact to carry a content‑hash and to record that hash in the project state. The current task list contains no step that generates or stores such hashes for any produced file (e.g., cleared_final.csv, model_metrics.json), violating the version‑ing discipline requirement.
